# Ahila Pillai — Product & Visual Designer

> Ahila Pillai is an experienced visual designer and illustrator who builds brands for technology companies in Web3, fintech, AI and e-commerce. She creates brand identities, visual systems, pitch decks, campaigns and landing pages for startups and global brands, and brings ideas to life through illustration and motion. Based in Bengaluru, India, and available for freelance and remote work.

- Home: https://madebyahila.com/
- Work page: https://madebyahila.com/work.html

- Motion work (YouTube): https://www.youtube.com/@ahilapillai7001
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/ahilapillai

## Services
- Product and app design (web apps, dashboards, mobile apps)
- Pitch deck and presentation design (investor decks, deck redesigns, sales enablement decks)
- Brand identity and visual systems
- Landing page and marketing website design
- Social media posters and campaign creatives
- Illustration and motion design
